name: Accelgor
description: It moves with blinding speed and lobs poison at foes. Featuring Accelgor as a main character is a surefire way to make a movie or comic popular.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Acid
moves.description: Opposing Pokémon are attacked with a spray of harsh acid. This may also lower their Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Absorb
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.description: The user lunges at the target at a speed that makes it almost invisible. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

moves.name: Acid Armor
moves.description: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply raising its Defense stat.

moves.name: Curse
moves.description: A move that works differently for the Ghost type than for all other types.

moves.name: Yawn
moves.description: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.

moves.name: Guard Swap
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def stats with the target.

moves.name: Acid Spray
moves.description: The user spits fluid that works to melt the target. This harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Water Shuriken
moves.description: The user hits the target with throwing stars two to five times in a row. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Mega Drain
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Struggle Bug
moves.description: While resisting, the user attacks opposing Pokémon. This lowers the Sp. Atk stats of those hit.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply raises the Speed stat.

moves.name: Giga Drain
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Power Swap
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with the target.

moves.name: U-turn
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Recover
moves.description: Restoring its own cells, the user restores its own HP by half of its max HP.

moves.name: Bug Buzz
moves.description: The user generates a damaging sound wave by vibration. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Final Gambit
moves.description: The user risks everything to attack its target. The user faints but does damage equal to its HP.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can’t move on the next turn.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply raises the Speed stat.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Leech Life
moves.description: The user drains the target’s blood. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status conditions.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Reversal
moves.description: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Sludge Bomb
moves.description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Spikes
moves.description: The user lays a trap of spikes at the opposing team’s feet. The trap hurts Pokémon that switch into battle.

moves.name: Sandstorm
moves.description: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except Rock, Ground, and Steel types. It raises the Sp. Def stat of Rock types.

moves.name: Giga Drain
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Baton Pass
moves.description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.

moves.name: Encore
moves.description: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves. It lowers the power of Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This attack move doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Mud Shot
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

moves.name: U-turn
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Power Swap
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with the target.

moves.name: Guard Swap
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def stats with the target.

moves.name: Toxic Spikes
moves.description: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

moves.name: Bug Buzz
moves.description: The user generates a damaging sound wave by vibration. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Drain Punch
moves.description: An energy-draining punch. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Focus Blast
moves.description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can’t move on the next turn.

moves.name: Venoshock
moves.description: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move’s power is doubled if the target is poisoned.

moves.name: Round
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round to increase the power of the attack.

moves.name: Venom Drench
moves.description: Opposing Pokémon are drenched in an odd poisonous liquid. This lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats of a poisoned target.

moves.name: Skitter Smack
moves.description: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.
